## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works end to end on staging with Fernhill's IdP: their metadata is loaded, the over-long RelayState was fixed with a short opaque ID stored in Redis, and JIT (#415, merged) creates Fernhill users as `viewer`. Group-to-role mapping (`Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` → `admin`, per-tenant setting) is written, tested (full suite green: 1301 passed) and open as PR #421; it can't be exercised until Fernhill adds the groups claim. The demo is Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 New York. (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 open, awaiting review; Fernhill IT still has to add the groups claim on their side (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] email Fernhill IT about the groups claim, then create an admin test account once it exists, before Thursday's demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] The full return URL as RelayState (143 bytes) failed: their ADFS enforces the 80-byte cap (`MSIS7042`); truncating was rejected as it breaks deep links (source: ses-sso-3, s3-03)
- [décision] `viewer` stays the default role and SP-initiated login stays on, until Maya talks to Fernhill (their IT asked for `analyst` default and IdP-initiated only) (source: s3-07, s1-05, src-slack-fernhill)
- [décision] Short opaque RelayState ID, return URL in Redis for 10 minutes (source: s3-03)
- [décision] JIT only accepts verified domains, never an unverified one even if the IdP asserts it (source: s2-03, src-pr415)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC for now; both login flows (source: s1-03)
